description: Mada hii inafundisha aina za sentensi katika Kiswahili, yaani sentensi sahili, sentensi ambatano na sentensi changamano, pamoja na vishazi, viunganishi na uchanganuzi wa msingi wa sentensi.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi yenye kishazi huru kimoja tu na inayotoa taarifa kamili huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: A simple sentence (sentensi sahili) contains only one independent clause and expresses a complete thought.

mcq.questionText: Ipi kati ya zifuatazo ni mfano wa sentensi sahili?

options.text: Mvua ilinyesha lakini sisi tukaenda shuleni.

mcq.explanation: Only the first option has a single independent clause with no conjunction joining two clauses, making it a simple sentence.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi ambatano huundwa kwa kuunganisha vishazi vya aina gani?
mcq.explanation: A compound sentence (sentensi ambatano) is formed by joining two or more independent clauses, usually with a coordinating conjunction.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Baba amefika na mama amepika chakula', neno 'na' linafanya kazi gani?
mcq.explanation: Here 'na' acts as a coordinating conjunction (kiunganishi) joining two independent clauses to form a compound sentence.

mcq.questionText: Sentensi changamano lazima iwe na nini?

options.text: Kishazi huru na angalau kishazi tegemezi kimoja

mcq.explanation: A complex sentence (sentensi changamano) must contain at least one independent clause and at least one dependent (subordinate) clause.

options.text: Hakitoi maana kamili kikisimama peke yake
Hutoa maana kamili kikisimama peke yake
Huwa ni sentensi kamili kila wakati

mcq.explanation: A dependent (subordinate) clause does not give a complete meaning when it stands alone; it relies on an independent clause.

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Nitakununulia zawadi ukifaulu mtihani', kishazi tegemezi ni kipi?
mcq.explanation: 'Ukifaulu mtihani' is the dependent clause because it cannot stand alone; 'Nitakununulia zawadi' is the independent clause.

mcq.questionText: Ipi kati ya hizi ni sentensi changamano?
mcq.explanation: Option A contains a relative dependent clause ('aliyelia jana') attached to the main clause, making it complex.

mcq.questionText: Viunganishi 'lakini', 'bali' na 'ila' kwa kawaida huonyesha uhusiano gani kati ya vishazi?
mcq.explanation: Conjunctions like 'lakini', 'bali' and 'ila' express contrast or opposition between clauses.

mcq.questionText: Sehemu kuu mbili za uchanganuzi wa sentensi sahili ni zipi?
mcq.explanation: In basic sentence analysis, a sentence is divided into two main parts: the subject (kiima) and the predicate (kiarifu).

mcq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Wavuvi wanavua samaki baharini', kiima ni kipi?
mcq.explanation: The subject (kiima) is 'Wavuvi' because it is the doer of the action, while the rest forms the predicate (kiarifu).

mcq.questionText: Kiunganishi 'kwa sababu' kwa kawaida huunda sentensi ya aina gani?
mcq.explanation: 'Kwa sababu' is a subordinating conjunction that introduces a dependent reason clause, producing a complex sentence.

mcq.questionText: Ni sentensi ipi kati ya hizi ni ambatano?
mcq.explanation: Option A joins two independent clauses with the coordinating conjunction 'kisha', forming a compound sentence.

mcq.questionText: Kirai ni nini katika uchanganuzi wa sentensi?

options.text: Kundi la maneno lisilo na kiima na kiarifu kamili
Neno moja tu lenye maana kamili

mcq.explanation: A phrase (kirai) is a group of words that functions as a unit but lacks a full subject-predicate structure, unlike a clause.

mcq.questionText: Ni kauli ipi iliyo sahihi kuhusu tofauti kati ya sentensi ambatano na changamano?

options.text: Ambatano huunganisha vishazi huru, changamano huwa na kishazi tegemezi
Zote mbili huwa na kishazi kimoja tu
Changamano haina kitenzi, ambatano ina kitenzi
Ambatano huwa na kishazi tegemezi pekee

mcq.explanation: A compound sentence joins only independent clauses, whereas a complex sentence includes at least one dependent clause.

fib.questionText: Sentensi yenye kishazi huru kimoja tu huitwa sentensi _____.
fib.explanation: A sentence with only one independent clause is a simple sentence (sentensi sahili).

fib.questionText: Sentensi inayoundwa kwa kuunganisha vishazi huru viwili au zaidi huitwa sentensi _____.
fib.explanation: Joining two or more independent clauses creates a compound sentence (sentensi ambatano).

fib.questionText: Sentensi yenye kishazi huru na angalau kishazi tegemezi kimoja huitwa sentensi _____.
fib.explanation: A sentence combining an independent clause with at least one dependent clause is a complex sentence.

fib.questionText: Kishazi kinachoweza kusimama peke yake na kutoa maana kamili huitwa kishazi _____.
fib.explanation: A clause that can stand alone and give complete meaning is an independent clause (kishazi huru).

fib.questionText: Kishazi kisichotoa maana kamili kikisimama peke yake huitwa kishazi _____.
fib.explanation: A clause that cannot stand alone is a dependent or subordinate clause (kishazi tegemezi).

fib.questionText: Maneno yanayotumika kuunganisha vishazi au sentensi huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Words used to join clauses or sentences are called conjunctions (viunganishi).

fib.questionText: Katika uchanganuzi wa sentensi, sehemu inayoonyesha mtenda wa kitendo huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The part of a sentence showing the doer of the action is the subject (kiima).

fib.questionText: Katika uchanganuzi wa sentensi, sehemu inayoeleza jambo kuhusu kiima huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The part of a sentence that says something about the subject is the predicate (kiarifu).

fib.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Nilipigwa na mvua nilipokuwa njiani', kishazi tegemezi ni '_____'.
fib.explanation: 'Nilipokuwa njiani' is the dependent clause indicating time; it cannot stand alone.

fib.questionText: Kiunganishi 'ili' kwa kawaida huonyesha _____ ya kitendo.
fib.explanation: The conjunction 'ili' introduces a purpose clause, showing the goal/purpose of an action.

tf.questionText: Sentensi sahili huwa na kishazi huru kimoja tu.
tf.explanation: True. A simple sentence contains exactly one independent clause.

tf.questionText: Sentensi ambatano huundwa kwa kuunganisha kishazi huru na kishazi tegemezi.
tf.explanation: False. A compound sentence joins independent clauses; combining an independent and a dependent clause forms a complex sentence.

tf.questionText: Kishazi tegemezi kinaweza kusimama peke yake na kutoa maana kamili.
tf.explanation: False. A dependent clause cannot stand alone with complete meaning; it depends on an independent clause.

tf.questionText: Neno 'na' linaweza kutumika kama kiunganishi kuunda sentensi ambatano.
tf.explanation: True. 'Na' can act as a coordinating conjunction joining two independent clauses into a compound sentence.

tf.questionText: Kila sentensi changamano ina angalau kishazi tegemezi kimoja.
tf.explanation: True. By definition a complex sentence must have at least one dependent clause alongside an independent one.

tf.questionText: Katika uchanganuzi wa sentensi, kiima na kiarifu ni sehemu kuu mbili.
tf.explanation: True. Basic sentence analysis divides a sentence into the subject (kiima) and the predicate (kiarifu).

tf.questionText: Kiunganishi 'kwa sababu' huleta kishazi cha sababu na hivyo kuunda sentensi changamano.
tf.explanation: True. 'Kwa sababu' introduces a subordinate reason clause, producing a complex sentence.

tf.questionText: Sentensi 'Mvua inanyesha sana' ni sentensi changamano.
tf.explanation: False. It has only one independent clause with no dependent clause, so it is a simple sentence.

tf.questionText: Viunganishi 'lakini' na 'bali' huonyesha upingamizi au tofauti kati ya vishazi.
tf.explanation: True. 'Lakini' and 'bali' are contrastive conjunctions showing opposition between clauses.

tf.questionText: Kirai ni sawa na kishazi kwa sababu vyote vina kiima na kiarifu kamili.
tf.explanation: False. A phrase (kirai) lacks a full subject-predicate structure, while a clause (kishazi) contains a verb with subject relation.

summary.correctAnswer: Sentensi yenye kishazi huru kimoja tu inayotoa maana kamili.
summary.explanation: A simple sentence has a single independent clause expressing one complete idea.

summary.correctAnswer: Sentensi inayounganisha vishazi huru viwili au zaidi kwa viunganishi.
summary.explanation: A compound sentence links two or more independent clauses using coordinating conjunctions.

summary.correctAnswer: Sentensi yenye kishazi huru na angalau kishazi tegemezi kimoja.
summary.explanation: A complex sentence has one independent clause plus at least one dependent clause.

summary.correctAnswer: Kishazi kinachoweza kusimama peke yake na kutoa maana kamili.
summary.explanation: An independent clause can stand on its own as a complete sentence.

summary.correctAnswer: Kishazi kisichotoa maana kamili bila kutegemea kishazi huru.
summary.explanation: A dependent clause needs an independent clause to give complete meaning.

summary.correctAnswer: Maneno yanayounganisha maneno, vishazi au sentensi kama 'na', 'lakini', 'kwa sababu'.
summary.explanation: Conjunctions join words, clauses or sentences; examples include 'na', 'lakini' and 'kwa sababu'.

summary.correctAnswer: Sehemu ya sentensi inayoonyesha mtenda au kinachozungumziwa.
summary.explanation: The subject names the doer of the action or what the sentence is about.

summary.correctAnswer: Sehemu ya sentensi inayoeleza kitendo au jambo kuhusu kiima.
summary.explanation: The predicate states the action or information about the subject.

summary.correctAnswer: Kazi ya kugawa sentensi katika sehemu zake kuu kama kiima na kiarifu.
summary.explanation: Sentence analysis breaks a sentence into its main parts such as subject and predicate.

summary.correctAnswer: Kundi la maneno lisilo na muundo kamili wa kiima na kiarifu.
summary.explanation: A phrase is a group of words lacking a full subject-predicate structure.

hoq.questionText: Sentensi 'Ingawa alikuwa mgonjwa, Amina alihudhuria shule kwa sababu alipenda kusoma' ina aina gani ya muundo?
hoq.explanation: It has one main clause ('Amina alihudhuria shule') and two dependent clauses introduced by 'ingawa' and 'kwa sababu', so it is complex with two subordinate clauses.

hoq.questionText: Sentensi 'Tulisubiri basi lakini halikuja, hivyo tukatembea kwa miguu' inafaa kuelezwaje?

options.text: Ambatano kwa kuwa inaunganisha vishazi huru kwa 'lakini' na 'hivyo'
Sahili kwa kuwa ina kitendo kimoja
Changamano kwa kuwa ina kishazi tegemezi

hoq.explanation: All three parts are independent clauses joined by coordinating conjunctions 'lakini' and 'hivyo', making it a compound sentence.

hoq.questionText: Katika sentensi 'Kitabu nilichokisoma jana kilikuwa na hadithi nzuri', ufafanuzi sahihi wa kishazi 'nilichokisoma jana' ni upi?

options.text: Ni kishazi tegemezi cha kirejeshi kinachofafanua 'kitabu'
Ni kishazi huru kinachoweza kusimama peke yake

hoq.explanation: 'Nilichokisoma jana' is a relative subordinate clause modifying the noun 'kitabu'; it cannot stand alone, so the whole sentence is complex.
